content.short: Brand Extender creates fully on-chain derivative NFTs from existing collections.
content.description: Brand Extender enables brands to activate partnerships or brand extensions by turning any NFT with open IP rights into fully on-chain derivative NFTs or derivative collections. It links the original NFT rights to the new on-chain assets and defines IP terms, secondary markets, and royalties for both existing and future holders. Brand Extender can mint 1-of-1 pieces or entire derivative collections for partners, collaborations, supporters, or to establish ongoing royalties across the ecosystem.
